common_instructions:
ROUND1 INDEPENDENT RESEARCH. New user mission,not continuation of the old gt done completion process. Read experiments/mpc-research/native-v2/master-research-report.zh-TW.md, native-identification-and-model-falsification.zh-TW.md, native-gpu-qualification-and-scout.zh-TW.md, original system-model.md/mpc-mathematical-specification.md and relevant source/artifacts. Base commit e75dbdd on research/pr33-batch-dynamics-v2,all data TRAIN/exploratory. The serial HTTP proxy was falsified:2004 bound vs2449 actual in90s. Never reuse that proxy as exclusive GPU service.
Each model independently answers the SAME core question:what identifiable batch-aware dynamical model and predictive control design can actually improve native vLLM goodput over fixed/one-move/reactive? Include complete state/action/disturbance/observation definitions,continuous batching and async clocks,causal identifiability/observability,comparison of queueing/fluid,batch-state-space,hybrid,learned,piecewise and probabilistic models;one/multistep/OOD evaluation;model uncertainty,EOS,remaining work,KV risk;objective and constraints,horizon/control rate/solver overhead/safe fallback;an experiment that can falsify each major assumption. Gateway budget16/32 is COST,not concurrency;vLLM scheduler-token budgets are not presently Gateway actuators. Explain when multi-step adds value vsOne-move and design a discriminating ablation,not horizon inflation.
Independent means do NOT read peers new Round1 reports or discuss conclusions before Mayor releases them. A/B/C/D below are emphasis only,not disjoint designs. Cite exact source/artifacts and distinguish facts from hypotheses. Existing raw archives in results/mpc-native-4090-scout include native-evidence.tar.gz,native-identification-train-evidence.tar.gz,native-profiler-evidence.tar.gz. Keep held-out160021-160024 unopened/unused;do not generate or tune on final held-out.
Bounded execution:produce your own report and ONE small genuinely useful reproducible CPU diagnostic/prototype with focused tests,not another full synthetic MPC benchmark or duplicated generic controller. Use only your allocated prefix/files. No SSH,GPU/API lifecycle calls,Push,Merge,Rebase,main/PRhead edits,remote changes or gt done. Technical guards block normal push/completion. Keep old evidence intact. Commit locally with Copilot coauthor,then mail Mayor with actual report/code hashes,commit,test command and result. Keep bead in_progress forRound2;do not invoke any automatic completion formula. Stop afterRound1 and wait for Mayor peer-review release. Be honest about tests not run and model/runtime unavailable. No broadcast to unrelated workers.
